01 // About

Who I Am

I'm a second-year Computer Science & Engineering student at RNS Institute of Technology, Bengaluru, specializing in Cybersecurity — with a builder's obsession for the intersection of AI, computer vision and human-centered interfaces.  From an AI-powered exam proctoring system that watches for suspicious behavior entirely in the browser, to a natural-language search concept for satellite imagery archives, I prototype fast and learn faster.  I work with Python, data structures & algorithms and modern web technologies, and I love taking a raw idea from hackathon pitch to a working interactive demo.
